meta.title: Make EnvironmentStatistics CPU usage collection interval configurable
meta.body_summary: Make the CPU usage collection interval in EnvironmentStatisticsProvider configurable via EnvironmentStatisticsOptions and extension methods, with default of 1 second, to reduce impact on other EventListener implementations like Application Insights.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot made CPU collection interval configurable; maintainer flagged unintended SDK version change and redundant code, which were fixed, but PR closed without merge after 51 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 80 changed lines, this is a very small change by absolute volume, adding a configuration option. As a minor configuration tweak, it should have been low-risk, but was closed without merge after a long period of inactivity, suggesting maintainers did not find it sufficient to warrant merging.

review_details.concern_detail: ReubenBond pointed out an accidental change in global.json (SDK version downgrade) and an unnecessary AddOptions call in DefaultClientServices.cs. Copilot addressed both in follow-up commits.
review_details.performance_claim: Making CPU collection interval configurable reduces impact on other EventListener implementations like Application Insights.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The change is a simple configuration addition; however, the agent introduced unintended side-effects (SDK version change, redundant line) that required maintainer intervention. The PR was eventually closed without merge, likely due to lack of compelling performance evidence or maintainer interest.

detection_detail.code_reading: ReubenBond reviewed the diff and questioned the SDK version change and redundant AddOptions line.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Only narrative claim that 1-second interval impacts Application Insights; no before/after evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After two follow-up commits addressing review comments, no further activity; PR closed by maintainer after ~51 days.

core_change_summary.description: Added EnvironmentStatisticsOptions class with CPUUsageCollectionInterval property, modified EnvironmentStatisticsProvider to use it, and added extension methods ConfigureCPUUsageCollectionInterval for silo and client builders. Also fixed an accidental SDK version change in global.json.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: global.json had an unintended SDK version change; DefaultClientServices had an unnecessary AddOptions line.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Added configuration classes, extension methods, and modified provider.
Fix: Reverted global.json SDK version to 8.0.115 per review.
Fix: Removed redundant AddOptions call in DefaultClientServices.

review_signals.summary: Questioned the change in global.json SDK version from 8.0.408 to 8.0.116.

Pointed out that the AddOptions<EnvironmentStatisticsOptions> line in DefaultClientServices.cs is unnecessary.
Responded that the SDK version change was unintentional and fixed, now set to 8.0.115.
Responded that the redundant AddOptions line was removed.

Within ~15 minutes, ReubenBond reviewed and questioned the SDK version change and unnecessary AddOptions call.
